description: This file contains controller functions for handling dataset-related API endpoints in an Express.js application, including CRUD operations and row management.

methods.name: getAllDatasets
methods.description: Handles fetching all datasets for a workspace with pagination.

methods.name: getDataset
methods.description: Fetches a specific dataset by ID within a workspace.

methods.name: createDataset
methods.description: Creates a new dataset within a workspace.

methods.name: updateDataset
methods.description: Updates an existing dataset by ID.

methods.name: addDatasetRow
methods.description: Adds a new row to a dataset.

methods.name: updateDatasetRow
methods.description: Updates a dataset row by ID.

methods.name: deleteDatasetRow
methods.description: Deletes a dataset row by ID.

methods.name: patchDeleteRows
methods.description: Deletes multiple dataset rows by IDs.
